name: Disneyland Galactic Grill Plain Angus Cheeseburger, Chicken Tenders or Morning Breakfast Burrito
whyItWorks: Tomorrowland's go-to counter for a plain American cheeseburger on a toasted bun, French fries, or a morning egg-bacon-cheddar breakfast burrito (ordered without salsa).
prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the Breakfast Burrito or French Toast Sticks with salsa on the side (do not use); for lunch/dinner, order a plain Cheeseburger with cheese only and fries.
watchOuts: Skip Galactic Grill's neon slushies and citrus-loaded specialty space lemonades
